blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Re-root the `gates.plan_review_precheck` cfg_root argument at claim.py:201 off the actual repo root (as done for `_config_default_assignee`) instead of `os.path.dirname(tracker)`.
evidence: gates.py:113: `if getattr(compose_config(cfg_root).verify, attr):` — the gate flag is read from cfg_root (the passed `os.path.dirname(tracker)`)

gates.py:379: docstring: "`cfg_root` is the REPO root (parent of the tracker), where `.rebar/config.conf` lives" — assumes tracker inside checkout, the exact assumption the commit message declares wrong for REBAR_TRACKER_DIR relocation

config.py:512: `return load_config() if root is None else load_config(root)` — a missing rebar.toml at cfg_root resolves to config defaults (gate off), not a ConfigError, so the mis-root fails silently open
blocking.finding: The commit fixes root inference for `_config_default_assignee` but leaves the identical `os.path.dirname(tracker)` root-inference bug on the sibling call `gates.plan_review_precheck(ticket_id, os.path.dirname(tracker), repo_root, ...)` in the same function. On a relocated store (the described MCP deployment: store at /var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets, repo at /app) `os.path.dirname(tracker)` points at a directory with no rebar.toml, so `gate_enabled` resolves `verify.require_plan_review_for_claim` from the wrong root — defaulting the flag OFF and silently disabling the plan-review start-work gate exactly where the bug being fixed already bit.
scenarios: Deployed MCP server with REBAR_TRACKER_DIR relocating the store outside the repo, with verify.require_plan_review_for_claim enabled in the repo's rebar.toml — the gate reads the wrong root, sees the default (off), and admits claims without a plan-review attestation.
blocking.suggested_fix: Resolve the cfg_root the same way `_config_default_assignee` now does — derive it from `repo_root` (discovering from CWD when None) rather than `os.path.dirname(tracker)` — and update `plan_review_precheck`/`_plan_review_gate_applies` docstrings that claim cfg_root is always the tracker's parent.
